## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Linux / Proton (portable) | `grim-dawn-trainer-*-linux-x86_64.zip` — unzip, then `sh start.sh` |
| Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) | `*_amd64.deb` |
| Linux (other distros) | `*_amd64.AppImage` |
| Windows | `*_x64-setup.exe` (or the `.msi`) |
| macOS / CrossOver | `*_universal.dmg` |

Linux requires GTK 3, WebKitGTK 4.1 and glibc 2.39+. Linux/Proton is the platform tested locally; the Windows and macOS builds are unsigned and unverified, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper will warn on first launch.

The runtime only attaches to the Steam x64 build 24825149 of Grim Dawn and refuses unknown builds. See the [README](https://github.com/ZackDow/GrimDawn-Trainer/blob/main/README.md) for usage and [validation notes](https://github.com/ZackDow/GrimDawn-Trainer/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md).

Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
